title: Standard operation for a layered gate
statement: Let $g$ be a Boolean DAG gate whose argument list has no repetitions and whose NOT gate, if it is a NOT gate, has exactly one argument. For any type $D$ and any assignment of an element of $D$ to each argument occurrence of $g$, the operation of the resulting layered gate belongs to the standard set consisting of the identity, NOT, and arbitrary-fanin AND operations on $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is well formed: its arguments are distinct and a NOT gate has exactly one argument
An embedding assigns an element of $D$ to every argument occurrence
